title: Boost Drive Shaft
text: Boost drive shaft speed, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Configuration} sets configuration; {Additional torque input} sets the external torque input External torque, {Shaft inertia, J_shaft} sets the inertia 1.55e-5, {Initial shaft speed, w_0} sets the speed, {Min shaft speed, w_min} sets the speed, {Max shaft speed, w_max} sets the speed and {Turbine mechanical efficiency, eta_mech} sets the efficiency. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Configuration
params.values: Specify configuration Turbocharger (default) | Turbine only | Compressor only

params.name: Additional torque input
params.values: Specify external torque input External torque input (default) | No external torque
